contexts.text: Haran () = the first state (of the Lord), which was obscure.
When he went from Haran () = the obscure state of the Lord, such as is that of the childhood of man. Explained.
Haran was a region where there was external worship; and, in fact, relatively to Terah, Abram, and Laban, idolatrous; but in the internal sense there is... only signified something obscure.
All these (scientifics) are called acquisitions; and, in fact, in Haran; by which is signified an obscure state such as is that from infancy to childhood.
And the soul which they had made in Haran () = every living essential which is possible in that obscure state, ... Haran = an obscure state.

Flee thee to Laban my brother, to Haran () = to the affection of external or corporeal good... Haran = what is relatively external, and thence obscure... What is properly signified here by Laban and Haran, may be evident from what follows... namely, the collateral good of a common stock.
He went to Haran () = to the good and truth of that degree. Haran = external good and truth; for by Haran is signified what is external; and by Laban, who was there, good and truth.
They said, We are from Haran () = from the good of a common stock. Haran = the collateral good of a common stock.
